entities.summary: Maite Perroni Beorlegui is a Mexican actress, singer, songwriter, and producer. She gained international fame in 2004 after starring in the Mexican youth telenovela Rebelde, which launched the pop-rock group RBD, nominated for a Latin Grammy.
